answer: Keep a jade token as a payment bond: every new identity must lock coins in escrow and can only earn them back by completing a deep chain of verified work over many epochs. Each task writes a signed receipt that links to the previous one like a thread, so a farm of clones must pay for the whole history honestly, not just the fee, and one bad link burns the bond. To stay alive the identity also has to answer an unpredictable challenge each epoch, which no lazy orchard of idle bots survives cheaply.
